title: Nadhani ni sawa kulipa kwa ajili ya programu 2 muziki!

text.According to Darwin's theory of evolutio: Kulingana na nadharia ya mageuzi ya Darwin, vitu visivyohitajika hupita polepole kupitia mageuzi.
text.But I want to use my own body to test wh: Lakini nataka kutumia mwili wangu mwenyewe kujaribu nini hutokea wakati wewe kulipa kwa ajili ya programu 2 muziki.
text.But music has never gone away, from long: Lakini muziki haujawahi kutoweka, tangu zamani za kale hadi sasa.
text.But recently, I started paying for YouTu: Lakini hivi karibuni, nilianza kulipa pia muziki wa YouTube.
text.For a long time, I paid only for Spotify: Kwa muda mrefu, nililipa tu kwa ajili ya Spotify.
text.I do not know if this will still continu: Sijui kama hii itaendelea katika miezi sita ijayo.
text.I think it is OK to pay for 2 music apps: Nadhani ni sawa kulipa kwa ajili ya programu 2 muziki!
text.In fact, when you listen to music, you f: Kwa kweli, unaposikiliza muziki, unahisi maneno ya wimbo huo, na huenda ukafikiri kwamba hauko peke yako.

text.Maybe that is because music is very impo: Labda ni kwa sababu muziki ni muhimu sana kwa watu.
text.On YouTube Music, you can hear the same: Kwenye YouTube Music, unaweza kusikia wimbo huo huo na sauti tofauti.
